notes.title: DPS2 is available.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27960422/df5a692b26ef9c180f1e3f13f43047afe4fc3fba.png[/img]

DPS2 is available, if you want to try it, 
first of all copy all your content (maps and custom tilesets) to a location other than DPS working folder, to prevent data loss.
After, right-click on DPS title in Steam Library, go Betas, and choose DPS2 from the dropdown.
While it is being downloaded you may watch the video about how to use it https://youtu.be/QIPlIRKrEvU
It describes the majority of approaches except for two fresh features.
First is the Perimeter tool (5th from the top) and the Texture Variant (6th from the top).
The perimeter works like a Plenty, but you needn't define the areas for it, 
because it takes it from its parent. When placed in a room, it is built inside, when placed in a building outside, you will find an example in "UnderdarkTones" map.
The texture variant can be added to Perimeter and Plenty entities, it has a lot of options, I'm sure you'll like it.
PS: to run the legacy version click the button on the left side of the splash.

notes.title: DPS2 features overview
notes.content:
Hi, I'm embarrassed you guys are waiting for me for so long,
on the one hand, the product is ready, and I would really like to share it,
on the other hand, while it doesn't quite meet my usability requirements,
given that users have even higher ones, I'm not in a hurry.
Today I recorded a video demonstrating the capabilities of the new DPS
to make it clearer how cool it is and why it took so long. 
https://youtu.be/QIPlIRKrEvU

notes.title: Better stability and performance.
notes.content: Hi, good news, DPS moved to the new SDK and now works better with resources of your computers. This will good impact on stability and performance, significantly reducing the risk of problems when exporting and working on large maps. The size of the rasterization regions is quadrupled, and most maps now are exported in a single pass.

notes.title: New token tool + 60 portraits
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27960422/e86325c76c96bb6029dd7dcca97c93ac41f30509.png[/img]
New tool allows to place tokens on the map instead of numeric and alphabetic marks, you also may change tokens background to encode opponents and neutral characters.
All images store in png files, so you import them to your favorite VTT.
In the foreseeable future, the collection will be replenished.

notes.title: [New Features] Undo/Redo, Effects Import/Export & Preview scaling.
notes.content:
Hi, I have 3 good news:)

Undo / Redo.
I covered most of actions with undo/redo functional, it remembers last 10 actions.
The intricate processes of drawing (polygon, paddle, arch) remained intact, but in the editing mode everything works.

Import / Export effects.
There are two buttons on top of Presets tab for saving and loading effect libraries.
The default library is located at the root of the DPS folder (default.dpf).
If you save your library over, it will be loaded every time you restart.

Preview scaling.
In the bottom right corner appeared a slider resizing previews,
the smaller the size, the more of them will be placed on the screen.

notes.title: New rotate and scale.
notes.content:
Hi, new rotate tool allows to define the point around which rotation applies. You may move it using drag&drop, than hold left mouse button to rotate selected layers. 
Buttons with specific angles of rotation moved to top additional toolbar.

Old enlarge/reduce options became scale tool. 

Union and substraction are available on top additional toolbar in move and rectangle selection modes, so texture browser enabled in all modes, and it makes possible to change textures using context menu on previews always. 

Think it's last UI update, and next updates will improve functionality, first of all undo/redo.

notes.title: Polygons union and substraction
notes.content:
Now it's possible to merge and subtract polygons. It works with layers and whole groups.
You will find buttons on bottom transform panel in move and select modes.
As I see it works fine with realy complex shapes even with holes.
[img]http://i.gyazo.com/ff808758861fa8c62b88a4571945c71c.png[/img]
Some details:
When you union selected layers, all selected plots, elipses and polygons will become one polygon. All layers contain old figures except one will be removed.
When you subtract, all layers except subtrahend will be modified if subtraction result is not empty, otherwise they will be deleted.

notes.title: UI Improvements.
notes.content:
[img]https://i.gyazo.com/008800e4a4a693b3a78dcc255a310a87.png[/img] 

New UI have two main goals:
1) get rid of unnecessary clicks when switching tools
2) unobtrusively reminiscent of hotkeys

Improvements have touched not only the upper toolbar, now DPS remembers
last used folder from previous tool and returns to it again after switching.
Tilesets cobobox moved near to the folders list, and although there is less space, I think this arrangement in more logical.
Object toolbar now contains flips buttons and scale slider.
The rotation tool is still removed, please use move tool to rotate.
In the near future, new tools will be added, stay tuned.

notes.title: World mapmaking and other news.
notes.content:
Hi, first of all now it's possible to create world maps using DPS.
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/779532369185772580/88634D23D027D00D9A460789C8863CB68BB09AE3/ [/img] 

Please, look at [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/592260/discussions/0/1290690926876896131/]this topic for details[/url]

For this aim new tileset "Jolly Roger's Atlas" was added.
We also imporved puddle tool and added spline tool to draw rivers and roads.
Also grid was was improved, and tow new context actions was added:
- polywall to group of single walls conversion
- group of walls conversion to polywall
